messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "maintenance dose may need to increase during infection"
set: ["maintenance dose may need to increase during infection", "maintenance dose may need to increase during fever", "maintenance dose may need to increase during condition flare", "maintenance dose may need to increase during another serious illness", "maintenance dose may need to increase after surgery", "maintenance dose may decrease afterwards", "dose may need adjusting", "doctor may need to adjust dose accordingly", "dose may need to be adjusted as diet changes", "may need to decrease dose rather than stopping suddenly", "may need to slowly decrease dose of other medication", "may need to temporarily stop taking", "increase dose slowly", "may need to restart medicine at lower dose to avoid stomach problems", "maintenance dose is not fixed", "doctor may need to adjust diabetes medications"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
